cocollective-cocollective:lever:f704d835.title: Strategy Director
cocollective-cocollective:lever:f704d835.description: Strategy Director co: is a creative and strategic transformation partner for purpose-led organizations. We help our clients put purpose into practice — not just defining what they stand for, but also infusing it into everything they do, inside and outside their organization. Not just because that’s good for the world, but because it’s good for business too. The role We’re looking for a Strategy Director to join our growing business and brand team. In this role you will work across multiple disciplines of strategy including organizational design, culture transformation, business, brand, and innovation partnering with purpose-led organizations across tech, biotech, CPG, healthcare, and more to align internal culture with brand and commercial ambition. Who you are You are an innately curious, seasoned leader with the gravitas to navigate complex strategic questions for a top-tier global client base. You don't just solve problems; you architect the approach, designing high-impact journeys that result in transformative brand stories. As a trusted advisor to C-Suite clients, you excel at building the long-term relationships that turn projects into partnerships. You have a proven track record of mentoring and growing a team of strategists, dedicated to elevating their thinking and ensuring rigorous excellence across every output. You have extensive experience leading high-stakes brand strategy and culture transformation endeavors—including organizational change, brand story and positioning, brand architecture, messaging, and futures thinking. Your background spans multiple disciplines, likely including business strategy, management consulting, product marketing, organizational change management, sustainability, or innovation, and you have worked with or for Fortune 500 and preferably Fortune 100 clients. You bring a highly proactive, can-do mindset to the business, looking for every opportunity to lean in—from driving new business and thought leadership to refining our internal strategic craft. You are a deeply collaborative leader who is just as comfortable setting the vision as you are rolling up your sleeves to ensure the work moves the needle. You see brand strategy as a powerful lever for change and are committed to crafting meaningful, purpose-driven work that makes a definitive impact on the world. What you’ll do As a Strategy Director, you are the engine of our strategic craft, and a pillar of team leadership and growth. You will lead multidisciplinary teams to solve the most ambitious business challenges—from defining a global brand’s future trajectory to navigating complex portfolio architectures. While you remain a practitioner at heart, your focus shifts to designing the strategic approach, stewarding the client relationship, and mentoring the next generation of talent. You can expect to: ● Architect the strategic approach: Using your deep expertise across brand architecture, positioning, and research, you won't just execute a brief; you will design the methodology. You will oversee the synthesis of complex data from primary research to C-Suite interviews to ensure our recommendations are both rigorous and actionable. ● Direct storytelling and organizational narrative: Lead the creation of compelling brand stories and purposes that provide clarity not just externally, but internally for Fortune 100 businesses. You’ll be responsible for ensuring our strategic outputs—whether messaging, naming, leadership narratives or culture frameworks—are not only insightful but designed to galvanize a client’s entire organization toward action. ● Evaluate organizational business processes and culture dynamics: Conduct systematic assessments of client organizations including organizational diagnostics, culture audits, stakeholder mapping, workflow analysis, and leadership alignment to identify friction points and develop evidence-based recommendations that help clients operate more effectively and execute against their strategy ● Steward

databricksventures-replit-com:ashbyhq:14.description: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. ABOUT THE ROLE: This is a Product Engineering role specialized in monetization systems, and will lead that space at Replit. It’s a direct line to business impact. But it’s also critical to get right for our users. These are some of the most critical user journeys to get right. Getting them wrong creates the most frustrating experiences for users. So we’re looking for engineers who can build reliable and scalable billing systems and abstractions, while also translating that to an intuitive and friendly user experience. YOU WILL: - Lead the architecture and implementation of monetization systems at Replit. - Create seamless payment experiences for users for both product-led and sales-led motions. - Build new abstractions and APIs for other engineers at Replit to monetize their new products. - Iterate on pricing and packaging tactics to drive revenue growth. Examples include coupon codes and referral systems. - Create monitoring and feedback systems so that we can proactively spot problems, fix them, and optimize performance. REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: - 6+ years of engineering experience, with strong skills working on the backend. - Direct working experience in at least one of the following: - Subscription platforms - Usage-based billing - SaaS Taxation - Payment platforms - Tokenization - Self-directed and comfortable working autonomously in ambiguous environments. - Excellent problem-solving skills with ability to debug complex billing issues and edge cases. - Experience implementing customer-facing billing interfaces that simplify complex pricing structures. TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE: - Python, TypeScript, React, Postgres, GraphQL, and Nodejs. BONUS POINTS: - Experience working with Orb, Metronome, or Stripe usage based billing. - Experience with coupons, referral programs, or other monetization growth tactics. This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Full-Time Employee Benefits Include: 💰 Competitive Salary & Equity 💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only) ⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance 🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability 🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave 🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays 🚗 Commuter Benefits (In-Office & US Only) 📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend 🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment 🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only) 🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings ☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only) Want to learn more about what we are up to? - Meet the Replit Agent https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IYiVPrxY8-Y - Replit: Make an app for that https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zd9hzngFwY - Replit Blog https://blog.replit.com/ - Amjad TED Talk https://youtu.be/kCudFI4tcpg?si=l4ViCejV_f2RZkDi Interviewing + Culture at Replit - Operating Principles https://blog.replit.com/operating-principles - Reasons not to work at Replit https://blog.replit.com/reasons-not-to-join-replit To achieve our mission of making programming more accessible around the world, we need our team to be representative of the world. We welcome your unique perspective and experiences in shaping this product. We encourage people from all kinds of backgrounds to apply, including and especially candidates from underrepresented and non-traditional backgrounds.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:8cbea094-c21d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager OTR based in the United States. This is a high-impact product leadership opportunity focused on modernizing a critical digital platform and transforming complex legacy systems into a unified, scalable experience. You’ll own product strategy, multi-year roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes for high-visibility initiatives. The role combines strategic product management with a strong user-experience mindset, partnering closely with UX researchers, designers, engineers, and business leaders. You’ll use data, analytics, and modern AI tools to accelerate discovery, improve decision-making, and shape intelligent product experiences. Success will require navigating ambiguity, influencing senior stakeholders, and balancing customer needs with technical and business priorities. You’ll also contribute to organizational product excellence by mentoring other product managers and establishing strong discovery and execution practices. This fully remote role offers the opportunity to influence large-scale platform transformation in a complex payments and commercial technology environment. Own the product strategy, multi-year roadmap, priorities, and business outcomes for a major digital platform modernization initiative. Translate organizational objectives into actionable product plans and lead complex initiatives from discovery through execution and go-to-market. Drive the modernization of legacy platforms, including migrating complex customer workflows and introducing scalable digital solutions while minimizing operational disruption. Partner closely with UX researchers and designers to apply user-centered design, customer journey mapping, usability principles, and product-led UX throughout discovery and delivery. Leverage generative AI and AI-powered tools to accelerate product discovery, automate documentation, analyze customer behavior, and assess opportunities for intelligent product capabilities. Define and monitor product metrics, OKRs, adoption indicators, and performance measures to evaluate outcomes and guide continuous improvement. Use analytics and executive dashboards to identify opportunities, understand product performance, and make data-informed prioritization decisions. Build alignment across engineering, design, business teams, and executive stakeholders while navigating ambiguity and complex technical or commercial trade-offs. Lead multi-quarter planning and complex product launches, ensuring effective execution and alignment across cross-functional teams. Mentor and guide junior product managers on product strategy, discovery methodologies, execution, and strategic decision-making. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, design, or a related discipline; a master’s degree in business, product management, product development, or marketing is preferred. 8+ years of professional product management experience, including ownership of outcomes for complex, multi-faceted product initiatives. Proven ability to establish long-term product strategies, develop multi-year roadmaps, and independently lead products or initiatives from discovery through go-to-market. Strong experience defining and applying product metrics to measure performance, adoption, and progress against strategic OKRs. Demonstrated expertise in platform modernization, legacy-system transformation, complex workflow migration, and scalable digital product development. Strong understanding of UX and user-centered product development, with experience partnering closely with UX/UI designers and researchers. Advanced proficiency with generative AI tools and AI-driven workflows for product discovery, documentation, behavioral analysis, and product innovation. Strong analytical capabilities and experience using interactive analytics tools, dashboards, and customer or behavioral data to guide pro

jobgether-jobgether:lever:9b8597a0-b38b-.title: ServiceNow Sr Developer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:9b8597a0-b38b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a ServiceNow Sr Developer based in United States. This is a fully remote opportunity for a senior software engineer specializing in ServiceNow development and IT Service Management (ITSM). You’ll play a key role in designing, enhancing, and maintaining a business-critical ServiceNow platform. The position combines hands-on development with collaboration across product owners, process owners, developers, and platform engineering teams. You’ll work extensively with ServiceNow architecture, workflows, integrations, custom applications, and ITSM capabilities, including Now Assist and AI-driven functionality. Your work will support platform stability, quality delivery, upgrades, deployments, and continuous improvement. The environment is Agile, collaborative, and focused on applying modern technology to complex enterprise and mission-driven challenges. This role is well suited to an experienced ServiceNow developer who enjoys solving technical problems and contributing to scalable platform solutions. Design, develop, configure, test, and maintain ServiceNow forms, flows, catalog items, workflows, integrations, and custom applications. Develop and enhance ServiceNow solutions across ITSM modules while applying platform architecture and development best practices. Work with product owners, process owners, developers, Scrum Masters, and platform engineers to translate business and technical requirements into effective solutions. Contribute to ServiceNow capabilities involving Now Assist, prompt engineering, agentic AI, and other emerging AI functionality. Participate in Agile ceremonies, including standups, planning, backlog grooming, estimation, and sprint activities. Apply quality assurance practices throughout the software development lifecycle, including testing, troubleshooting, debugging, and documentation. Support ServiceNow platform upgrades, patching, releases, deployments, and ongoing maintenance activities. Investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and implement reliable solutions that improve platform performance and stability. Promote adherence to established ServiceNow and enterprise development standards, processes, and best practices. Collaborate effectively across technical and business teams to ensure solutions are delivered on time and meet defined requirements. Requirements: 7+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience, preferably within an ITSM environment. At least 3 years of experience working with prompt engineering, Now Assist, agentic AI, or related AI-enabled ServiceNow capabilities. Strong knowledge of ServiceNow architecture, modules, configuration options, development practices, and platform capabilities. Extensive experience with forms, UI policies, client scripts, business rules, workflows, integrations, catalog items, and custom applications. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification, or the ability to obtain the certification within 90 days. High school diploma required; an associate or bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline is preferred. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills. Experience working within Agile/Scrum software development environments. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. Strong documentation skills and attention to quality throughout the development lifecycle. Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a distributed, collaborative team. Must be a U.S. person. Preferred certifications include Certified Implementation Specialist – ITSM, Certified Application Developer – ITSM, advanced ITSM certifications, and ITIL v4 certification. Benefits: Salary range: $97,968–$126,500, depending on experience, geographic location, and applicable contractual requirements. Remote work:

southparkcommons-meesho:lever:5cc451b2-7.description: About the Team Being part of Meesho's Fulfillment and Experience (F&E) team, will zip you to the cockpit of our ever-burgeoning rocketship. And, you’ll shape the experience of Bharat’s next billion e-commerce users. We’re an eclectic mix of over 100 professionals, all driven by the first principles of problem-solving. We come with diverse skill sets and responsibilities ranging from running operations/support to managing the supply chain, and maintaining analytics. At Meesho, we’re trying to do what's never been done before – herald e-commerce into the tier-2, tier-3 cities of India. Our team’s role in this ambitious mission is to reimagine logistics from the ground up completely. This means a host of "zero-to-one" projects (takers, anyone?) to build a supply chain that reimagines e-commerce, not just in India but globally. We focus on personal growth and fun at work just as much as we do on working hard. That is why, we have regular 1-1s virtual meetings, fun-filled monthly all-team catch-ups, and timely rewards and recognitions About the Role As a Cluster Head - Security and Investigations at Meesho, you’ll run a Regional org focused on reducing Security incidents and identifying, reducing and resolving malicious losses and frauds on the ground. You’ll achieve it by forging strong collaborations with the Business and Operations teams, Operations partners and Sellers alike. You’ll work closely with the mentioned teams in order to serve our users better. To this end, you’ll also lead key initiatives, audits, formulating and implementing SOPs and deliver impactful projects to cater to security and loss prevention needs for the organization. Your guiding question in this role will be “How can we build an efficient, fraud-free, high on ownership and integrity supply chain, while keeping customer experience at max”. You’ll answer this question every day through owning the Security and Investigations charter for the Fulfillment and Experience, and Meesho at large. Develop and Lead the Cluster Security and Investigations Charter for a Region comprising multiple states. ● Coordinate with stakeholders from Operations and Central Control tower, Legal, Trust & Safety and other relevant teams to design short and long-term security, loss and fraud identification and prevention strategies. ● Partner with Cluster and Area operations teams to mitigate risk of theft, fraud and other high impact incidents. ● Performing risk assessment of site & operation model and frame mitigation measures. ● Regularly do security analysis, and work with Central teams for setting the right SOPs across nodes. ● Conduct regular security and process audits on the ground based on central data inputs ● Close the audit exercise by ensuring corrective measures and action on the identified stakeholders (employees/delivery personnel/sellers/ops vendors). ● Create Org and liaisoning muscle to intervene in case of ops disruptions and untoward incidents happening in different parts of the region. 8-12 years of work experience with substantial experience in managing a geographically dispersed security, investigations and loss prevention team, with KRs around detection and prevention of security and loss incidents. ● Experience in Physical security operations and Investigations, preferably in E-commerce, Fulfillment, 3P Logistics, Supply chain, Operations, or relevant security experience in similar high growth tech startups. ● Outstanding organizational skills. ● Superior problem-solving and incident and case management skills. ● Experience in team building, managing, and coaching will be a plus. ● Knowledge & experience of laws applying to police & legal action and the judicial process. ● Ability to travel, sometimes at a short notice
